header.note: Coordinates are [lon, lat] ints x scale degrees, flat rings, no closing vertex, exterior CCW, holes CW (as seen in lon/lat). Antarctica's land polygon follows -180..180 and closes along lat -90; ice covers most of it (draw Antarctica as ice). Polygons crossing the antimeridian are split at +-180 by Natural Earth.
source: Natural Earth 10m physical (public domain): land, minor_islands, lakes, glaciated_areas, antarctic_ice_shelves_polys
Inside the region box (region.json clip, ~600 km around NYC) the fine LOD land is replaced by OSM-derived region coarse land (ODbL) at 100.0 m tolerance
